name: library
description: Library catalogue records (MARC 260/264): bracketed inferred dates, '[17_]' patterns, copyright and 'cop.' noise, two-digit years read within 1900-1999 ('08 = 1908 unless it would be in the future), and 'early'/'late' as halves: early 15th century = 1400-1449, late = 1450-1499, mid = the middle half (1425-1474); early 1950s = 1950-1954, late = 1955-1959, mid = 1952-1957.
